Record Class AbstractTransactWriteBuilder.Operation

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.builder.base.AbstractTransactWriteBuilder.Operation
Record Components:
type - the operation type
table - the table reference (either DynamoDbTable or DynamoDbAsyncTable)
item - the item to put or update, or null for delete/condition check
partitionKey - the partition key value for delete/condition check, or null for put/update
sortKey - the sort key value for delete/condition check, or null for put/update or tables without a sort key
conditionExpression - optional condition expression for condition check operations
updateExpression - optional update expression for update-with-expression operations
Enclosing class:
AbstractTransactWriteBuilder<S extends AbstractTransactWriteBuilder<S>>
public static record AbstractTransactWriteBuilder.Operation(AbstractTransactWriteBuilder.Operation.Type type, Object table, @Nullable Object item, @Nullable Object partitionKey, @Nullable Object sortKey, @Nullable ConditionExpression conditionExpression, @Nullable UpdateExpression updateExpression) extends Record
Stores a table reference, operation type, and optional item, key values, condition expression, and update expression. The table is stored as Object to accommodate both DynamoDbTable and DynamoDbAsyncTable types without coupling the base to either package.

      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
